title: Negating a literal
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let an assignment give each of $n$ variables a sign in $\{\pm1\}$, and let a literal specify a coordinate and its required sign. The negated literal holds under the assignment if and only if the original literal does not hold.
hypotheses_covered: the assignment is a sign vector of length $n$
the literal has a coordinate in $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and a required sign
